items.title: Why the Dow Is Outperforming Today
items.summary: The Dow maintained gains in afternoon trading, while the S&P 500 and the Nasdaq slid.  The blue chip index was up 0.7%, or 461 points, despite sharing some of the same components dragging on the Nasdaq and the S&P 500.  The key to the Dow's resilience during Wednesday's session is its price-weighted structure.

items.title: S&P 500, Dow Build on Record Highs Amid AI and Iran Hope
items.summary: Stocks were on track to break more records on Wednesday, as the AI trade and hopes of an Iran peace deal continued to power the broader market higher.  S&P 500 futures rose 0.4%.  Dow Jones Industrial Average futures added 240 points, or 0.5%.
